title: Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K Max, 1st gen 2021 (AFTKA, codename kara), Fire OS 7.7.1.3 (PS7713/5443, build PS7713.5443N),
header:
Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K Max, 1st gen 2021 (AFTKA, codename kara), Fire OS 7.7.1.3 (PS7713/5443, build PS7713.5443N),
Android 9 (SDK 28), 2 GB RAM, Colombia. Based on amazon-fire-tv-stick-lite-2020/.

FIRE OS: DEBLOAT ONLY. com.amazon.tv.launcher is a protected package and keeps Home; launcher/ does not apply.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<stick ip> tools/disable.sh examples/amazon-fire-tv-stick-4k-max-2021/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<stick ip> tools/restore.sh examples/amazon-fire-tv-stick-4k-max-2021/debloat.txt com.amazon.tv.launcher
Everything is DISABLED for user 0, never uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.
ADB on Fire OS 7: Settings > My Fire TV > About, click the device name 7 times, then Developer Options > ADB Debugging.

Rebooted twice after applying: everything below stayed disabled; Home, Prime Video, Netflix and voice search work.
With Alexa voice search kept, these come back enabled at every boot, so they are not listed: com.amazon.aca,
com.amazon.aiondec, com.amazon.audiohome, com.amazon.whad, com.amazon.whasettings, com.amazon.wha.mediabrowserservice,
com.amazon.tv.alexaalerts, com.amazon.tv.alexanotifications, com.amazon.alexa.externalmediaplayer.fireos,
com.amazon.alexamediaplayer.runtime.ftv, com.amazon.whisperjoin.middleware.np, com.amazon.tv.ffsprovisioneeclient,
com.amazon.tv.mattercohost, com.amazon.ods.kindleconnect, com.amazon.naatyam, com.amazon.storm.lightning.tutorial.

Kept on purpose: com.amazon.tv.launcher, com.amazon.tv.settings.*, com.amazon.venezia (Appstore), com.amazon.tv.ime,
remote/Bluetooth services, OTA updates, Alexa voice search (com.amazon.vizzini, aria, ivona TTS, tcomm), Prime Video
(com.amazon.firebat), Silk (com.amazon.cloud9, com.amazon.tv.website_launcher), casting (cast.sink, dialservice,
awvflingreceiver, whisperplay, whisperlink), profiles (com.amazon.prism.android.service), com.amazon.tv.oobe.

The hero rotator on Home is the launcher's own content feed; this list does not remove it.
